objections.claim: The declared closed-writer invariant is incomplete. The custody-drift oracle queries only collaborators and their permissions, but GitHub App installations are a separate authorization surface and may hold `actions`, `contents`, or `administration` write permissions without appearing as collaborators ([GitHub App installation API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/apps/installations), [GitHub App permissions](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/authentication/permissions-required-for-github-apps)). Such an unrecorded installation can survive `custody-drift` and directly mutate releases or dispatch an off-main workflow. Environment protection gates only jobs that reference the environment, while workflow YAML can adjust `GITHUB_TOKEN` permissions; therefore the substituted definition can omit the environment and request write authority ([GitHub permission calculation](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax#how-permissions-are-calculated-for-a-workflow-job)). The `v*` tag ruleset also leaves nonmatching release/tag names available, so the later integrity sweep detects unauthorized publication only after public mutation. Enumerate and fail closed on every repository-writing credential class—including effective GitHub App installation permissions and write-enabled deploy keys—or impose a platform-level denial, with regressions proving these principals cannot mutate any release or dispatch a privileged workflow.

The two-sandbox negative-test mechanism does not make the mutation the only changed variable: sandbox A and sandbox B necessarily have different absolute paths, directory identities, and usually role-revealing names. An input-ignoring oracle can return zero when executed from the baseline sandbox and nonzero from the negative sandbox solely by inspecting `cwd` or the sandbox path, satisfying every stated check without reading the mutated governed input. The proposed relocation-sensitive fixture catches only an oracle that fails in every temporary copy, not this pair-selective attack. Recreate both pristine executions at the same canonical absolute path with controlled environment and fresh state, or otherwise equalize/conceal sandbox identity, and add a path-selective input-ignoring oracle regression that must produce `oracle-nondiscriminating`.
